purpose: diagnose whether pH-dependent interactions improve within-design held-out Lab prediction
not_claimed: This is not unseen-phone or unseen-factor-level generalization.
primary_comparison: ph_dependent_interactions minus additive_nuisance; negative error differences favor the full interaction model
bootstrap: paired errors averaged by strip and resampled within phone
limitations: Other light observations from the same strip remain in training; this is intentional because the analysis tests factorial structure rather than unseen-strip prediction.
Categorical interaction models cannot directly predict a phone level absent from training, so LOPO is not used here.
